description: Compute the convex hull of a set of points — the smallest convex polygon that contains all the points. Useful for bounding area analysis, estimating coverage area, or wrapping a set of locations. Works offline without API calls.

points.description: Points to compute the convex hull from (minimum 3)

name: convex_tool

geometry.description: GeoJSON Polygon geometry of the convex hull, or null if hull could not be computed

title: Convex Hull
